input.summary: Insert vendor insurance provision in General Provisions
input.comment: [Playbook] We have added a standard insurance provision, as our playbook requires vendors that host our platform and process our transaction and order data to carry CGL, E&O and cyber cover. If the cyber limit is an issue we can discuss E&O of USD 1,000,000 and cyber of USD 2,000,000 as a fallback.

ops.text: (l) INSURANCE. Licensor shall maintain, at its own expense, throughout the term of this Agreement and for one (1) year thereafter: commercial general liability insurance of not less than US$1,000,000 per occurrence and US$2,000,000 in the aggregate; professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than US$2,000,000; cyber liability and privacy insurance of not less than US$5,000,000; and workers' compensation insurance as required by applicable law. Licensor shall provide Licensee with certificates of insurance evidencing such coverage upon request.
